name: Health Connect Record Types 2026
methodology: Every record class in Google's Health Connect data-types table (https://developer.android.com/health-and-fitness/health-connect/data-types), read on 2026-10-03, joined to each class's Jetpack reference page. Class name, category, record shape, unit class, mandatory fields and the read/write permission strings are copied from Google's data-types table; the permission evidence column keeps the table text the strings were read from. Aggregate metrics, availability, feature flags and the description are copied from the Jetpack reference. Nothing is inferred: a field Google's pages do not state is null. Where Google's own pages disagree (the data-types table and the HealthPermissions reference spell one exercise-route permission differently), the record page shows both readings; this dataset carries the data-types table's string.
generatedFrom: src/data/healthConnectRecords.ts (generated by scripts/fetch-health-connect-records.mjs, then by scripts/build-datasets.mjs)

fields.category: Google's category for the data type, as printed on the data-types page
fields.recordShape: Interval, Instantaneous or Series, per Google's table
fields.unitClass: Unit class Google's table names; null where none
fields.mandatoryFields: Fields Google's table lists as mandatory, semicolon-separated
fields.readPermissions: android.permission.health read strings for the class, semicolon-separated
fields.writePermissions: android.permission.health write strings for the class, semicolon-separated
fields.permissionEvidence: The table text the permission strings were read from
fields.aggregateMetrics: AggregateMetric constants on the class, semicolon-separated; null where none
fields.addedIn: Availability as the Jetpack reference prints it
fields.description: The first paragraph of Google's class description, verbatim
fields.googleDocs: Google's Jetpack reference page the row was read from
fields.page: This site's page for the record
